body.name: Total full-covariance calendar-block interval
body.construction: Fix \(\alpha_{\mathrm{tr}}=\alpha_{\mathrm{cal}}=\alpha_{\mathrm{don}}=\alpha/3\), \(g_T=\lceil3\log(T\vee2)/|\log\rho_0|\rceil\), \(\ell_T=\lceil T^{1/3}\rceil\), and \(M=\lfloor T/(\ell_T+g_T)\rfloor\). Form consecutive retained blocks \(I_1,\ldots,I_M\) of length \(\ell_T\), separated by discarded gaps of length \(g_T\), and let \(R_T=\bigcup_{b=1}^{M}I_b\). Apply exactly the donor folds, projected complementary-fold centers, bandwidth grid and selection rule, and raw local-polynomial intercepts of \texttt{def:feasible-estimator} using only historical rows in \(R_T\); call the result \(\widehat\tau_R\). For every \(b\), rerun this retained-data construction after deleting \(I_b\), without reassigning donor folds or changing the bandwidth grid, and call it \(\widehat\tau_R^{(-b)}\). On successful fits set \(G_{sk}^{R}=\sum_{t\in R_T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}w_{stk}b_r(u_{stk})b_r(u_{stk})^{\top}\), \(a_{stik}^{R}=e_0^{\top}(G_{sk}^{R})^{-1}w_{stk}b_r(u_{stk})\), and thus \(e_0^{\top}\widehat\gamma_{sk}^{R}=\sum_{t\in R_T}\sum_i a_{stik}^{R}Q_{sti}\). Define \[A_L=C_{r,d}L\sum_{s=1}^{S}(\pi_s/K_D)\sum_{k=1}^{K_D}\sum_{t\in R_T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}|a_{stik}^{R}|\,\|X_{st}-\widetilde z_{sk}\|_2^{\lambda}.\] Define \(J_b=M\widehat\tau_R-(M-1)\widehat\tau_R^{(-b)}\), \(\bar J=M^{-1}\sum_bJ_b\), \(C_b=J_b-\bar J\), and \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{cal}}=\{M(M-1)\}^{-1}\sum_bC_b^2\). Define \(E_{si}=(\pi_s/n_s)(B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}-\bar B_s^{\mathrm{obs}})\), \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{tr}}=\sum_s\sum_iE_{si}^2\), and report \(\widehat V=\widehat V_{\mathrm{cal}}+\widehat V_{\mathrm{tr}}\). Conditional on the data, draw mutually independent Rademacher variables \(\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_M\) and \(\eta_{si}\), and set \(G_{\mathrm{cal}}^{\#}=\{M(M-1)\}^{-1/2}\sum_b\xi_bC_b\) and \(G_{\mathrm{tr}}^{\#}=\sum_s\sum_i\eta_{si}E_{si}\). With the exact conditional Rademacher law and randomized tie-breaking when needed, set \(r_{\mathrm{cal}}=\inf\{r:P_{\#}(|G_{\mathrm{cal}}^{\#}|\le r)\ge1-\alpha_{\mathrm{cal}}\}\) and \(r_{\mathrm{tr}}=\inf\{r:P_{\#}(|G_{\mathrm{tr}}^{\#}|\le r)\ge1-\alpha_{\mathrm{tr}}\}\); a finite zero empirical variance gives radius zero. For donor fold \(k\) with complementary size \(m_k\), put \(D=Sd\), \(Y_j=\Sigma^{-1/2}(Z_j-z_0)\), \(M_4(m_k)=B/m_k+(1-1/m_k)(D^2+2D)\), \(q_k=\{K_DM_4(m_k)/\alpha_{\mathrm{don}}\}^{1/4}\), \(\delta_k=\sqrt{C_\Sigma/c_\Sigma}\,q_k/\sqrt{m_k}\), and \(A_{\mathrm{don}}=(C_{\mathrm{mod}}/K_D)\sum_k\delta_k^\kappa\). The factor \(\sqrt{C_\Sigma/c_\Sigma}\) accounts for Euclidean projection onto \(([0,1]^d)^S\) and conversion back to the full-\(\Sigma\) norm. The feasible \(\widehat\Sigma\) remains the spectrally clipped covariance estimate, while the uniform donor radius uses only the known class constants. On the good sample set \(H_\alpha=r_{\mathrm{cal}}+r_{\mathrm{tr}}+A_L+A_{\mathrm{don}}\) and \(C_\alpha=[-B,B]\cap[\widehat\tau_R-H_\alpha,\widehat\tau_R+H_\alpha]\). The bad-sample event is the union of \(M<3\); some \(m_k<1\); failure of any full-sample or delete-one-block selected Gram matrix at its declared eigenvalue threshold; nonfiniteness of a required fit, pseudo-score, variance, or conditional multiplier quantile; undefined spectral clipping; and \(\max_k\delta_k>\delta_0\). On this event set \(C_\alpha=[-B,B]\).
